d: Short, straight light-blue hair with blunt-cut bangs, adorned with a bright red headband and matching red ribbons. Narrow, light-purple eyes with a calm, neutral expression on a youthful face. A slender build, wearing a black halter-neck bikini top, a black and deep-purple high-low coat with red accents and white lining, and matching black thigh-high boots with white soles and red ribbon laces. Signature details include a large, white and black futuristic cannon held in the arms and a small silver pendant around the neck.
